key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:0E90
name: initialize_library_state_two
description: Stores the value two in a 16-bit state word, calls a library function through a jump-table entry, then calls a routine and calls it again if the state word is not six.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:0ECC
name: initialize_library_state_eight
description: Stores the value eight in a 16-bit state word, calls a library function through a jump-table entry, then calls a routine and calls it again if the state word is not six.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:0F08
name: set_state_three_release_lock
description: Stores three and a parameter in global state, calls a library function and a wait-and-retry routine, then calls directory and lock routines and releases a lock when a check returns nonzero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:0F96
name: set_state_seven_and_return
description: Stores seven and a 16-bit parameter in global state, calls a library function and a wait-and-retry routine, then returns the stored parameter value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:0FDC
name: initialize_library_state_ten
description: Stores ten and two parameters in global state, calls a library function and a wait routine, and calls the wait routine again if the state word is not six.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:102E
name: transfer_dungeon_save_record
description: Checks a status byte and a stored code, then uses DOS open, read, write and close calls with dungeon file names to transfer a 52-byte record, returning 1 on a read failure and 2 on a size mismatch.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:1248
name: prompt_game_disk_until_ready
description: Suppresses the system requester by setting a process field, locks the game disk, and loops showing disk-status messages until the check reports ready, then restores the field and unlocks the disk.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:139A
name: dispatch_sprite_draw_by_code
description: Loops over queued draw entries and dispatches each by type: type-two entries are drawn according to a value range, and type-eight entries are routed through a switch on a code to rendering routines, ending when a terminal value is reached.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:14DA
name: setup_sprite_group_loops
description: Runs a series of setup calls, then for each of four groups calls a per-group setup routine and six per-item routines, and finishes with more setup calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:1668
name: calculate_nine_sprite_offsets
description: Calls the sprite offset routine nine times, once for each index from zero to eight.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:16CA
name: forward_sprite_offset_calculation
description: Forwards its call directly to the sprite offset calculation routine and returns, adding no logic of its own.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:171E
name: store_sprite_slot_offset
description: Computes a value from a passed coordinate plus an index times nine minus one, stores it in the entry for that index, then calls two routines and passes the index to a third.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:176A
name: configure_sprite_rendering_params
description: Sets fixed word-sized parameters, calls the rendering setup routines for the indexed entry using an index-derived value, and calls the setup routine again with fixed values.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:1806
name: dispatch_sprite_render_case
description: Checks an index against a stored value, derives a switch value from a computed difference, and dispatches to one of ten cases that call rendering routines, then makes three further calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:1908
name: find_matching_sprite_range
description: Scans a ten-entry table of stored x and y bounds and returns the one-based index of the first entry whose range contains the given point, or zero if none match.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:196E
name: adjust_sprite_entry_counters
description: When a per-entry value is not twenty and a second counter is nonzero, increments one counter for the given index and decrements the current entry's counter, then makes two calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:1AD2
name: check_sprite_value_tens
description: Reads a stored value for the given entry, divides it by ten, and calls three routines when the quotient is zero or two routines otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:1BEC
name: draw_entry_text_buffer
description: Clears the text buffer for an entry, positions its text, draws the string if the buffer is nonempty, and when a second flag is set draws a further text element in a fixed style.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:1CD8
name: clear_entry_text_byte
description: Looks up an entry value and, if nonzero, tests two status bits, then clears either the entry's last character slot or its first byte before making two calls to refresh the display.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:1D0E
name: clear_entry_text_character
description: Tests two status bits returned by a routine and, unless either is set, clears a character slot in the entry selected by a register argument, then makes two calls with the entry index.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:1D3E
name: clear_entry_char_and_refresh
description: Clears a character slot in the entry selected by a register argument, calls routines with the value one, then makes two more calls and a final call with the entry index.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:1D8E
name: store_entry_text_character
description: Reads an entry value and, when it is not twelve and a second routine returns nonzero, stores that result as a character at the index, clears the following slot, and makes four calls.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:1E42
name: find_matching_table_index
description: Scans a 26-entry table of 16-bit values for the given value and returns the matching position offset by sixty-five, or zero when no entry matches.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:200E
name: call_then_invoke_pointer
description: Calls one routine, then invokes a second routine through a function-pointer slot in a global table, and returns nothing.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2036
name: allocate_memory_block
description: Calls a routine and then requests a memory block through the Exec library allocation call from the library table.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2068
name: allocate_graphics_resources
description: Allocates a state block and returns status one if that fails. Otherwise it stores the block and the custom chip base address, opens the graphics library, fills in pointers from further allocation calls, and returns a status code that reports the step reached.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:214C
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns, with no loop or condition in its body.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2178
name: process_pair_list_with_library
description: Calls a library function, then walks a list of two-word records, calling another library function for each record until a record's second word is minus one, and finally calls a third library function.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:21BC
name: stub_no_operation
description: Contains only a return and performs no work; it is a stub and not a meaningful routine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:21CA
name: cleanup_allocated_resources
description: Releases entries from two tables of pointers through a release routine, closes a library if its handle is set, and then calls the release routine once more.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:222E
name: initialize_custom_chip_state
description: Stores saved values into the state block, disables all interrupts, re-enables selected interrupt and DMA bits through the custom chip registers, sets a flag word, and calls nine routines.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:22B0
name: configure_copper_and_dma
description: Disables interrupts, writes DMA control values and copper list pointers taken from the state block, and re-enables selected interrupts, while also updating two global words.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2338
name: wait_then_clear_interrupt
description: Polls a status word until its interrupt bit is set, writes that bit to the interrupt request register to clear it, and returns the status value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:234A
name: wait_and_clear_repeatedly
description: Waits for the interrupt request bit and clears it, repeating this the number of times given by the parameter.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2362
name: wait_for_byte_flag_loop
description: Computes an iteration count from a parameter and a stored multiplier, then for each iteration clears a status byte and busy-waits until another routine sets it nonzero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:237A
name: forward_single_routine_call
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other logic.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2388
name: build_copper_list
description: Writes a copper list into memory from stored bitplane and sprite pointers, adding sprite pointer moves, a block of color register moves from a table, and terminating words.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2634
name: copy_seventeen_word_blocks
description: Copies a 17-word block from a fixed offset in a source area into a buffer, then copies a second 17-word block from later in that area into the buffer at a further offset.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2666
name: get_state_pointer_offset
description: Returns a global pointer value increased by ninety-six.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2676
name: store_state_word_param
description: Stores the passed 16-bit value into a fixed field of the state structure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2680
name: fill_copper_entries_by_flag
description: Checks a flag returned by a routine. When it is zero, clears a state flag and fills fourteen copper list longwords with a wait command; otherwise fills seven longwords with a register write and sets the flag to one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:26C4
name: copy_global_words_to_list
description: Stores the result of a routine into a state word, sets a second word to minus one, and copies six words from a global table into a list at eight-byte intervals.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:26EE
name: run_clamped_motion_loop
description: Inverts a flag byte and increments a counter, then waits until another flag is set by clearing words in two structures. It then repeatedly computes two coordinates from scaled table offsets, clamps each between stored bounds, stores them, and calls two routines per pass, looping indefinitely.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:272C
name: dispatch_through_unresolved_table
description: Makes an indirect call through a jump-table address that the decompiler could not recover, so its real target cannot be determined from this code alone.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2730
name: copy_masked_status_and_flag
description: Copies the low bits of one status word, masked by a fixed value, into a register field of another structure and sets a flag byte to one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2748
name: write_eight_to_field
description: Calls one routine, stores the value eight into a fixed field of a structure, and returns with the register values it received unchanged.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:275C
name: forward_to_unresolved_handler
description: Pushes the address of a handler and makes an indirect call through a jump-table address the decompiler could not recover, so the target is unknown from this code alone.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2760
name: countdown_toggle_and_refill
description: When a status flag is set, counts a timer down and on reaching zero toggles a state word and reloads the timer, then either fills six entries with a fixed value or copies six words from a global table into them, ending with an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2790
name: reload_timer_and_copy_words
description: Sets a countdown field to twenty-six, copies six words from a global table into a list at eight-byte intervals, then makes an indirect call through an unresolved jump-table target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:27BA
name: emit_pending_display_entries
description: When a pending flag is set, clears it and copies twelve words from a source block into a list. If an index is nonnegative it writes six entries built from a global table and clears the index, then makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2820
name: initialize_input_state
description: Sets a pointer field to a block 1024 bytes past a base address, zeroes counters and markers, stores a byte from a global table along with its tenth-part quotient, sets a limit of ten, and stores the results of two routines in state bytes.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2878
name: advance_sequence_value_every_third
description: When a flag is set and a frame counter is a multiple of three, reads the next word from a sequence, restarting from a default value when it reaches zero, stores it in a structure field, then makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:28EE
name: store_state_byte_and_dispatch
description: Stores a byte returned by a routine into two state bytes, calls a routine, and makes an indirect call through an unresolved jump-table target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2902
name: update_input_region_state
description: Reads a state value and, when it changes, scans a table of five-word regions for one whose bounds contain the current position and whose flag bits match, then runs the matching action. A second check does the same for another flag, after which it updates state bytes, decrements a counter when nonzero, and makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2922
name: scan_input_regions_and_update
description: Scans a table of five-word regions for one whose flag bits match and whose bounds contain the current position, then runs its action. If a second state value changed it does the same scan for another flag, then updates state bytes, decrements a counter when nonzero, and makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:295A
name: check_second_region_then_update
description: Runs the second-flag region check against the current position, then updates state bytes, decrements a counter when nonzero, and makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:296A
name: pre_call_second_region_update
description: Makes two routine calls, runs the second-flag region check against the current position, then updates state bytes, decrements a counter when nonzero, and makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:298E
name: search_second_region_then_update
description: Scans the five-word region table for a second-flag entry containing the current position and runs its action on a match. Otherwise it falls through to update state bytes, decrement a counter when nonzero, and make an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:29C6
name: store_input_state_and_dispatch
description: Calls a routine, stores a byte returned by another routine into state bytes, calls a further routine and calls one more unless the result is minus one, decrements a counter when nonzero, and makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:29D6
name: refresh_input_state_and_dispatch
description: Calls a routine, stores a byte returned by another routine into state bytes, calls a further routine and calls one more unless the result is minus one, decrements a counter when nonzero, and makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2A1C
name: decode_keyboard_serial_byte
description: When a ready bit is set, clears the handshake flag, sets it again, and decodes the inverted, rotated keyboard serial byte. For codes in a narrow range it records a press or release in a key-state byte, then returns the decoded code, or minus one when no byte is ready.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2A7A
name: set_key_state_bit
description: Sets one bit, chosen by the low three bits of its argument, in a key-state byte and returns minus one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2A82
name: read_state_byte
description: Returns the byte stored at a fixed offset from the global state pointer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2A8E
name: clear_state_and_buffer
description: Sets several state bytes and words to zero or fixed values, stores fifteen in a counter location, and clears a buffer of 336 words.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2AC0
name: cycle_frame_buffer_pointers
description: Advances a buffer offset in steps of two that wrap at forty-two, copies eight pairs of frame bytes from two source pointers into the buffer at interleaved offsets, and updates a pointer to the buffer. It also steps a row index between zero and eight, copies a seven-word row from a table into a list, and makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2AE6
name: cycle_frame_buffer_on_timer
description: When a timer byte is nonzero it decrements it and, on underflow, resets it and performs the same frame-buffer copy and offset advance as its sibling routine. It then steps the row index and makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2BC6
name: step_row_index_and_copy
description: Unless the row index is eight, increments it and copies a seven-word row from a table into a list, then makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2BF6
name: call_then_return_first_result
description: Calls a routine to obtain a 16-bit value, calls a second routine, and returns the first value.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2C16
name: read_next_buffered_character
description: While data is pending, reads the next byte from an eighty-entry circular text buffer, moves the read index back with wraparound, and returns the character code minus thirty-two multiplied by eight. When the buffer is empty it clears a pending flag and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2C3E
name: clear_pending_flag_return_zero
description: Clears a pending flag byte and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2C46
name: write_text_string_to_buffer
description: Walks a null-terminated string, passing each character to a routine and setting a pending flag, until the routine returns a nonzero value, which it returns; it returns zero at the end of the string.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2C68
name: write_circular_buffer_byte
description: Writes a byte at the current index of an eighty-entry circular buffer, then decrements the index with wraparound. If that would reach the read index it leaves the index unchanged and returns one, otherwise it returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2C8C
name: set_circular_buffer_index
description: Stores the passed value as the buffer index and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2D2E
name: decrement_nine_timers
description: Decrements each of nine 16-bit timers that is nonzero, then makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2D44
name: initialize_motion_state
description: Sets the position, bounds and motion fields of a state structure to fixed constants and zero, copies a value from a parameter block into a state word, clears flag bytes, and copies one stored longword into four consecutive slots, then calls a routine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2DCC
name: update_clamped_motion_position
description: When a motion flag is zero, clears several counters; otherwise computes new coordinates from scaled offsets and a routine result, clamps them between stored bounds, and stores them. It then calls two routines and makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2E40
name: clamp_position_then_dispatch
description: Clamps two coordinate parameters against stored bounds, stores the results as the position, calls two routines, and makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2E56
name: store_position_clamped_y
description: Stores the position from its inputs, clamping only the second coordinate against a stored bound, calls two routines, and makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2E74
name: advance_clamped_position
description: Adds stored offsets to the current position, clamps the sums between stored bounds, stores the new position, calls two routines, and makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2E86
name: clear_motion_counters
description: Zeroes several counter words and longwords in two structures, then makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2EA6
name: compute_counter_axis_deltas
description: Stores two new 8-bit counter values as the previous sample and returns a signed movement delta for each axis, unwrapping the 8-bit overflow of each difference.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2EE6
name: compute_single_axis_delta
description: Returns a value derived from one counter and a flag, and a signed delta between two 8-bit counter values with overflow unwrapped.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2F0E
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work; it is a stub.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2F24
name: record_sample_and_store_result
description: Stores the current pair of position words into a four-entry history indexed by a rotating counter, advances that counter, and writes either a value from a routine or zero into two output words, depending on a flag and a count.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2F7A
name: store_history_outputs_with_offset
description: Decrements a counter that wraps to three, obtains a value from a routine, zeroes it when a count is zero, and writes it to several output fields, including one with eight added.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:2FF2
name: compute_packed_position_flags
description: Adds stored position words to two inputs, sets bit flags from the high bits of the sums and the low bit of the first coordinate, and packs the results into a combined return value with a fixed flag bit set.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:303E
name: read_fire_button_state
description: Returns minus one when bit six of a stored status byte is clear, and zero otherwise, which reports a pressed fire button.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3052
name: sample_port_counters_safely
description: Disables the master interrupt bit, saves the two 8-bit movement counters read from the mouse port data register into state bytes, stores two input bytes, and re-enables the master interrupt bit only if it was previously set.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:308C
name: store_state_words_atomically
description: Disables the master interrupt bit, stores two word inputs into state fields, and re-enables the master interrupt bit if it had been set.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:30BA
name: store_two_state_words
description: Stores two word inputs into two state fields without changing any interrupt control.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3200
name: pop_event_queue_entry
description: Pops the next entry from a 128-entry ring of queued pairs. When the queue is active it waits for a pending count to become nonzero, clears the source slot, advances the ring index with wraparound, and returns the entry; otherwise it returns a marker record carrying the current position.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:32C8
name: clear_event_queue
description: Resets three queue counters to zero, zeroes all 128 pairs of longwords in the queue table, and re-enables the master interrupt bit if it was set before.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:330C
name: set_queue_active_flag
description: Sets the queue-active word to one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3318
name: clear_queue_active_flag
description: Sets the queue-active word to zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3322
name: store_masked_flags_check_bit
description: Stores the input word with bits eleven to thirteen cleared into a state word, sets a state byte to minus one when its low bit is clear, and returns that low bit.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:336A
name: enqueue_event_entry
description: When the masked flag bits match and the queue has room, scans for a free slot in a 128-entry table, records its address in a ring, advances the ring index with wraparound, and stores two input words followed by two state words.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3390
name: append_event_record
description: Records a buffer address into a 128-entry ring, advances the ring index with wraparound, then writes two input words and two state words into that buffer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:33C0
name: compute_scaled_countdown_byte
description: Multiplies the register input by a stored word, divides the product by sixty, makes a zero result one, and stores the low byte in a state byte.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:33E2
name: copy_linked_records_to_buffer
description: Walks a linked list of five-word records, copying each into a contiguous buffer with two fields derived by adding offsets, then writes a minus-one terminator and re-enables the master interrupt bit if it was set before.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:342A
name: render_text_with_blitter
description: Clears a 16-entry text buffer, copies glyph rows and mask rows for each character of the string from two tables into it, then programs the blitter with pointers, sizes and masks and waits for each blit to finish, repeating six times.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3524
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work; it is a stub that many routines call.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:352E
name: initialize_text_and_state_fields
description: Points two state fields at offsets inside the state structure, zeroes several flags and counters, sets a timer to thirty, and writes a fixed DMA control value to the custom chip register.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3572
name: swap_display_buffers_and_wait
description: Copies six words from a source structure into state fields, toggles a buffer-select byte, swaps two pointers between buffer slots to match, and waits until a pending flag is cleared.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3886
name: call_two_setup_routines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:38A4
name: compute_sprite_buffer_offset
description: Calls one routine, stores an offset computed as the register input times 576 plus 96 into a global variable, then calls another routine.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:38CA
name: render_entries_until_terminator
description: Repeatedly calls a routine for each five-word entry in a table, advancing five words at a time, until an entry's first word is negative.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:38E0
name: render_sprite_stripes
description: Reads a sprite descriptor, sets blitter control values from its coordinates and a row offset, and starts five blits, waiting for the blitter to be idle before each one. When the descriptor's low coordinate bits are nonzero it repeats five blits with an adjusted mask and width.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:39F6
name: store_render_params_and_render
description: Stores three input values into global variables, then calls two routines.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3A54
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Calls two routines and then reaches bad instruction data that the decompiler could not decode, so no further behaviour can be recovered.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3A6E
name: render_five_blit_stripes_indirect
description: Stores a stacked pointer, derives a stripe offset from a descriptor's coordinates, programs the blitter, starts five blits while waiting for the blitter to be idle before each, then makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3AFE
name: render_clipped_or_direct_blits
description: Stores two input coordinates in a sprite record, then either programs five direct blits from the record's source addresses or, when a flag bit is set, computes clipped blit parameters into globals and returns early if the object is off-screen.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3BBE
name: calculate_clipped_sprite_bounds
description: Computes clipping bounds for a sprite from its position and size, stores the row offset and word masks in globals, and returns early when it falls outside the limits. Otherwise it writes the source and destination addresses for the blit.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3F36
name: wait_and_write_index_bytes
description: Loops sixteen times, each time waiting on two status flags, calling a routine, and writing a computed byte through a pointer. The byte depends on the loop index and on whether the direction input is nonzero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:3FD6
name: decrement_nibbles_in_table
description: Walks a table of four-byte entries, decrementing each non-zero nibble of the entry's second word by one and writing the word back.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4010
name: increment_differing_nibbles
description: Walks a table of four-byte entries, comparing the high, middle and low nibbles of each entry's second word with the matching nibbles of a source word table. Each nibble that differs is incremented by one and the word is written back.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4062
name: clear_five_longword_buffers
description: Clears 2000 longwords at each of five buffer addresses taken from a pointer array in the state structure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4084
name: process_four_channel_records
description: Walks four channel records from last to first, and for each active record a type code selects one action: set a channel bit, load a source record's address and length and enable its channel, or write a default length. It decrements each type code and finishes with an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:40B6
name: process_channel_records_loop
description: Repeats the four-record channel processing with the same type-code actions, decrementing each record's type code until the index wraps past zero, then makes an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:40FA
name: dispatch_channel_record_actions
description: Initialises a record with a default length and a state value, then walks the four type codes from last to first, performing a set-bit, load-source or skip action for each and decrementing it, and finishes with an indirect call to an unresolved target.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4118
name: write_jump_table_entry
description: Writes a type code of two into a table entry at the given index, stores the upper word of the first argument alongside it, and stores a pointer offset from the routine's own location by eight times the lower word of the first argument.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4134
name: write_dispatch_table_entry
description: Writes the same type code, word and offset pointer as its neighbouring entry writer, storing them at the index given by the second argument.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:41AE
name: forward_buffer_and_args_call
description: Passes a fixed buffer address, the argument and the caller's stacked arguments to a routine and returns that routine's result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:41D4
name: copy_bytes_to_buffer
description: Copies a counted run of bytes from a source address into a destination buffer one byte at a time and returns the destination address.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4264
name: stub_return_without_work
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:426C
name: allocate_and_tag_record
description: Allocates a record and releases it if allocation fails. Otherwise it fills fixed fields, writes a four-character tag, fetches data through library calls, and copies in a parameter block or sets flag bits before calling a routine with the result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4400
name: tokenize_command_string
description: Copies a command string into a buffer while splitting it into tokens at spaces, tabs, form feeds and line breaks, keeping double-quoted tokens whole. It counts the tokens, allocates an array of pointers to them, and fills that array.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:45BC
name: append_string_with_limit
description: Finds the terminator of the destination string, then appends characters from the source string until its terminator or a counted limit is reached, terminates the result, and returns the destination address.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:45BE
name: append_string_capped_copy
description: Finds the terminator of the destination string, then appends characters from the source string up to a counted limit, terminates the result, and returns the destination address.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:45E2
name: read_icon_tooltype_entries
description: Opens icon.library and looks up a tool-type argument named by the referenced text. When it is present, reads its entries into a newly allocated array, stores the count and pointer in the record, and closes the library.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:46CC
name: append_whole_string
description: Finds the terminator of the destination string and copies the whole source string, including its terminator, to that point, returning the destination address.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:46CE
name: append_string_at_terminator
description: Locates the terminator of the destination string and copies the source string, including its terminator, to that point, returning the destination address.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:46E2
name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies characters from a source string into a destination buffer up to a counted limit, stopping after the source terminator. Any remaining part of the limit is filled with zero bytes, and the destination address is returned.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4712
name: create_message_port
description: Allocates a signal bit and a port record, returning zero if either fails. On success it sets the record's node type to message port, stores the signal number and the calling task, initialises the port's message list or calls a routine for it, and returns the record.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:47B4
name: release_message_port_record
description: Releases a message port record: removes it through a library call when linked, marks its node type as invalid, sets a signal field to minus one, and calls two library routines to free the remaining resources.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4806
name: format_printf_style_output
description: Parses a format string, copying literal characters into an output buffer and expanding percent directives with flags, width, precision and argument values. Numeric conversions use digit tables for upper- and lower-case letters, and the routine returns the number of characters written or minus one on overflow.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4CFE
name: measure_string_length
description: Advances through a zero-terminated byte string and returns the number of bytes before the terminator.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4D10
name: initialise_empty_list
description: Initialises an empty linked list header: its head points at its own tail slot, the tail is cleared, and the tail-predecessor points back at the header.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4D22
name: process_records_in_range
description: Calls one routine for each 22-byte record in a fixed address range, moving from the first record to the last.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4D48
name: write_buffered_stream_byte
description: Writes one byte into a stream buffer, flushing it when full or when a newline arrives in line-buffered mode, and passing minus one flushes instead. Returns the byte written, or minus one on error.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4EC8
name: close_buffered_stream
description: Releases a buffered stream. Returns minus one for a null or inactive stream; otherwise it flushes if needed, closes its handle, frees a generated name built from five digits when present, clears the stream's fields, and returns zero on success or minus one on failure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4EEA
name: close_stream_and_clear_fields
description: Closes a buffered stream's handle, frees its generated five-digit name buffer when present, clears its fields, and returns zero when all steps succeed or minus one otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4F8C
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without performing any other work.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4F96
name: flush_buffered_streams
description: When given a stream, flushes that stream. When given a null stream, flushes every open entry in the stream table, returning minus one if any flush fails and zero otherwise.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4FD4
name: flush_remaining_streams
description: Walks the remaining stream table entries, flushing each open entry, and returns minus one on the first failed flush or zero when the table is exhausted.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:4FE6
name: call_single_routine_return
description: Calls one routine and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:500E
name: stub_empty_routine
description: Performs no work and returns; it is an empty stub.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:501C
name: call_and_sign_adjust_result
description: Calls a routine, then returns the register pair with its second value negated when the first input was negative.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:5036
name: call_and_return_pair
description: Calls one routine and returns a 64-bit pair made from the original low register value and the value the call leaves in the second register.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:5042
name: call_routine_then_return
description: Calls one routine and returns, adding no other logic.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:504C
name: divide_32bit_with_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor, using a shift-and-subtract loop when the divisor exceeds sixteen bits and 16-bit division otherwise, and returns the quotient and remainder as a packed pair.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:509C
name: allocate_node_buffer
description: Checks a node's index against a fixed record, then gives the node a 1024-byte buffer from a library call, or falls back to a one-byte buffer inside the node when allocation fails. It sets the node's flag bits and points its buffer pointers at the start of the buffer.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:5112
name: unlink_and_free_node
description: Searches a singly linked list for the given node, unlinks it when found, and frees it through a library call. Returns zero if the node is not in the list.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:5122
name: find_and_unlink_node
description: Walks a singly linked list to locate the node passed in a register, unlinks it by joining its predecessor to its successor, and frees it through a library call, returning that result. Returns zero if the node is not found.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:5138
name: unlink_node_from_predecessor
description: Unlinks a node using a predecessor address held in a register, or the list head when there is none, then frees the node through a library call.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:5140
name: set_list_head_and_free
description: Sets the list head to the first word of a node and releases that node through a library call.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:515A
name: free_all_list_nodes
description: Releases every node in the linked list through a library call, then clears the list head and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:5164
name: free_list_nodes_until_end
description: Walks the linked list, calling a release routine for each node until the chain ends, then clears the list head and returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:518A
name: allocate_linked_node
description: Allocates a node of the requested size through a library call, stores the size in it, and links it at the head of the list. Returns the address of the usable area after the link fields, or zero when the request is zero or allocation fails.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:51D4
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies a null-terminated source string into the destination buffer, including its terminator, and returns the destination address.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:51E2
name: check_stream_is_interactive
description: Validates a file slot index; invalid or empty slots set an error code of three and return minus one. Otherwise it asks DOS whether the handle is interactive and returns one for yes or zero for no.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:5244
name: seek_stream_slot_position
description: Validates a file slot index, then asks the file system for the current position. If that fails it records the DOS error and returns minus one; otherwise it calls the same file routine again with the position as argument.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:52D4
name: delete_file_or_record_error
description: Calls a DOS routine that deletes a file. On failure it records the DOS error code and returns minus one, otherwise it returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:5306
name: stub_constant_zero_return
description: Returns zero without any other work.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:530A
name: write_to_stream_slot
description: Validates a file slot index and that the slot is open for writing, returning minus one with error codes three or six when it is not. For slots with a flag set it repositions the file first, then writes through the file routine, recording the DOS error on failure and returning minus one or the write result.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:53B8
name: check_status_flag_and_handle
description: Calls a library routine for a status word; when bit twelve is set it returns that word if a stored pointer is nonzero, otherwise it calls a routine. In every case where no action applies it returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:53EE
name: write_four_bytes_to_output
description: Writes four bytes from a global buffer to the standard output, makes a second DOS call, and calls a routine with the argument one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:5428
name: run_callback_list
description: Runs each callback in a linked list in turn, advancing through the list, then calls a final cleanup callback if one is set, and finally calls a routine with its argument.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:545A
name: close_slots_and_release_resources
description: Closes every open file slot, then tears down the state by invoking stored release callbacks, restoring a saved pointer, closing libraries, releasing a lock and freeing a saved buffer where present. It returns its argument.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:55B4
name: stub_bare_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfp:0:55BA
name: close_stream_slot
description: Validates a file slot index, closes its file through DOS unless the slot's flag bit is set, clears the slot, and returns zero. Invalid slots set error code three and return minus one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0000
name: run_program_entry_setup
description: Stores the startup argument, opens the required system libraries, copies startup fields into globals, runs setup steps including timed waits and a DMA enable, and then loops on interrupt and status flags.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:02E2
name: is_fire_button_pressed
description: Returns true when bit six of a stored status byte is clear, which reports a pressed fire button.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:02F2
name: is_control_bit_clear
description: Returns true when bit two of a hardware status byte is clear.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0306
name: wait_for_second_flag
description: Returns immediately when the first of two adjacent state words is zero. Otherwise it busy-waits until the second word becomes nonzero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0314
name: fade_objects_each_frame
description: Runs 105 frame steps, each waiting for the top of frame and then, for four graphics objects, reducing a timer by two (clamped at zero) and storing a scaled value derived from the object's stored byte. A graphics routine is called between steps.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:037C
name: open_data_file_check
description: Opens a named data file through DOS, stores the returned handle, and returns true when the open failed.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:03B6
name: copy_source_offset_blocks
description: Copies 3000 blocks of four longwords from a source area, offset by 12000 longwords, into the destination area.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:03D4
name: clear_and_copy_bitmap_block
description: Calls a graphics library clear routine, then copies 8000 longwords from a source area offset by 12000 longwords into the destination area.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0400
name: read_entries_until_flag
description: Walks a table of nonzero words, calling a DOS read routine through the library table for each entry, and stops at the first zero entry or when a flag in the structure becomes nonzero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0448
name: read_table_entries_until_flag
description: Walks a table of nonzero words, calling a DOS read routine through the library table for each entry, and stops at the first zero entry or when a flag in the structure becomes nonzero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0498
name: read_entry_table_until_flag
description: Walks a table of nonzero words, calling a DOS read routine through the library table for each entry, and stops at the first zero entry or when a flag in the structure becomes nonzero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:04D8
name: call_dos_read_routine
description: Calls one DOS read routine through the library table and returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:04FE
name: fade_palette_down_steps
description: Runs sixteen steps, each waiting for the top of frame, decrementing the nibble values of a colour table and loading the palette with a graphics call. Afterwards it clears a status word in the structure.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:053A
name: decrement_nibbles_in_word_list
description: Walks a list of words, decrementing each non-zero nibble of each word by one and writing the word back.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0572
name: fade_palette_up_steps
description: Runs sixteen steps, each waiting for the top of frame, incrementing nibbles that differ from a target palette and loading the palette with a graphics call. Afterwards it sets a status word to one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:05B8
name: increment_nibbles_toward_target
description: Walks two word lists in step, incrementing each nibble of the first word that differs from the matching nibble in the second, and writing the word back.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0608
name: blit_multi_source_blocks
description: Takes exclusive use of the blitter, then for sixteen steps waits for frame timing and programs the blitter with source and destination addresses, modulo values and sizes, waiting for each block to finish. It releases the blitter afterwards.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:071A
name: store_channel_bit_mask
description: Stores a single-bit mask for a channel index when the low six bits of the input are below four. Otherwise the stored mask is left unchanged.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0738
name: run_sixteen_steps_then_clear
description: Calls one routine sixteen times, then sets a global variable to zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:074E
name: setup_channel_sample_state
description: Looks up a pointer for a channel. When it is present and the channel index is below four, it sets that channel's bit in a mask word; in every case it records the sample length, address and volume fields in the channel state, then calls two routines to finish the setup.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:07AA
name: set_channel_sample_fields
description: Stores a channel's sample address and length fields from its inputs. Short lengths point the channel at a fixed one-word area and set a flag; longer ones store the length, or a default when it is zero, and compute the current sample pointer from the base address and offset.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:07E8
name: set_channel_sample_pointer
description: Writes a channel's length and auxiliary fields and computes its current sample pointer from the base address and offset, storing the result in the channel state.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:07F2
name: store_channel_state_fields
description: Stores a length value and an offset-derived pointer into the channel state, then copies a secondary value into two state fields.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0834
name: halt_in_infinite_loop
description: Contains no work and loops forever, so it never returns.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:084E
name: copy_channel_pointer_if_flagged
description: When bit zero of the input is set and a channel's sample field is nonzero, copies that field and a 16-bit value into the destination record, then returns the input shifted right by one.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:086A
name: process_channel_flags_when_active
description: When a global flag is nonzero, stores a value from a routine, calls four routines, then performs the same conditional copy as its neighbour and returns the shifted flag bits; otherwise it returns zero.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0AD2
name: advance_sequence_playback_tick
description: Advances a playback tick: when a counter reaches its limit it resets the counter and decodes the next block of packed entries, storing each channel's note, length and volume fields.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0B1C
name: decode_sequence_channel_commands
description: Decodes packed entries for four channels, each supplying a channel's note, length and volume, while command values near the top of the byte range select actions such as pausing, jumping or stopping playback. Returns the position where playback stopped.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0BF6
name: apply_channel_command_step
description: Applies the pending command to the current channel: a special marker value sets its state, a repeat command adjusts a stored count, and other commands call an effect routine. It then steps the channel index and loops until all channels are processed.

key: black crypt (1992)(electronic arts)[cr trsi](disk 1 of 3)[f dtc]/Black Crypt (1992)(Electronic Arts)[cr TRSi](Disk 1 of 3)[f DTC].adf:bcdfq:0:0C04
name: apply_channel_command_variant
description: A variant of the command step that returns the sequence position when it reaches a stop command, and otherwise updates the channel state for the next tick.
